I need to determine the additional clockwise rotation in degrees that the current object should undergo to align its facing direction with the reference direction.

The reference direction is indicated by the finger in image 1, which is pointing lower-right. So I need to analyze the current facing direction of the object in image 2.

The current object in image 2 is facing upward. Now I need to calculate the angle between upward and lower-right. This can be considered as the angle between the positive y-axis and the line connecting the center of the object to the lower-right direction.

The reference finger in image 1 is at the 45-degree mark on the clock (lower-right direction). Looking at the current object in image 2, the upward direction is at the 0-degree mark on the clock.

The angle between 0 and 45 degrees is 45 degrees. Therefore, the additional clockwise rotation needed is 45 degrees.
